The '''''Rogue''-class Gunship''' was a [[gunship]] used by criminal factions during the [[Imperial Era]]<ref name="Outlaws" /> and the [[New Republic Era]].<ref name="Chapter 6" /> During the age of the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Pyke Syndicate]] used the gunship for to support its criminal operations.<ref name="Outlaws" /> Later, the [[Ranzar Malk's crew|crew]] of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] led by [[Ranzar Malk]] out of his [[space station]] [[Roost]], used a hidden ''Rogue''-class Gunship to betray the [[Mandalorian]] [[Din Djarin]] and attempt to shoot him down in the ''[[Razor Crest]]''. As the gunship was attempted to takeoff, however, a [[homing beacon]] placed by Djarin summoned a [[New Republic]] [[starfighter]] [[squadron]] to the station and they destroyed the gunship and destroyed Roost.<ref name="Chapter 6" />

{{Ship-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Rogue''-class Gunship first appeared in "[[Chapter 6: The Prisoner]]," the sixth episode of the [[2019]] [[Disney+]] web-TV series ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]''. The concept art showcased in the episode's credits featured the gunship as appearing closer to the design of a [[Rogue-class Porax-38 starfighter|''Rogue''-class Porax-38 starfighter]].<ref name="Chapter 6" /> The [[2024]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Outlaws]]'' established the name of the ''Rogue''-class Gunship.<ref name="Outlaws" />
